source_url.title: Source URL
source_url.description: Public URL of the PDF, Image, or Website to extract data from.
source_url.patternErrorMessage: Please enter a valid HTTP or HTTPS URL

target_schema.title: Target JSON Schema
target_schema.description: Define the JSON structure you want extracted. Example: {'total': 'number', 'items': 'array', 'date': 'string'}

use_gpu_ocr.title: Use GPU OCR (DeepSeek)
use_gpu_ocr.description: Enable for handwriting, complex scans, or poor quality documents. Costs more but provides better accuracy.

proxy_configuration.title: Proxy Configuration
proxy_configuration.description: Configure proxies to avoid blocking and improve success rates.

max_retries.title: Maximum Retries
max_retries.description: Maximum number of retry attempts for failed operations (1-5).

timeout_seconds.title: Timeout (seconds)
timeout_seconds.description: Maximum time to wait for processing (30-300 seconds).
